text: Simplicicar is operated by Simplicicar France (SIREN 814099040), whose registry entry lists founder Yoni Dayan (born 1985) as company leader; AS Monaco's partners page describes the network as founded in 2011 by Yoni Dayan.

source.name: Annuaire des Entreprises / recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr — Simplicicar France (SIREN 814099040)

additionalSources.name: AS Monaco — Les partenaires de l'AS Monaco
additionalSources.quote: Fondé en 2011 par Yoni Dayan, Simplicicar est un réseau spécialisé dans la vente et l'achat de véhicules d'occasion
